Name: Gender Neutral Hot Springs
Author: Hanatsuki
Description:
A gender neutral update for Nanogamer7/Nan0penguin's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3110]Bathhouse Hot Spring[/url] mod. Requires the original mod to function correctly.

Allows you to enter either door at the Hot Springs and removes the 'W' and 'M' from the doors.

If using with the Gender Neutrality Mod set the bathhouse options in GNM to false.

Also compatible with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10548]Solarium (Rooftop Spa House)[/url] mod by bahbahrah! Simply add both mods and follow the steps on the Solarium mod page to unlock the Solarium!

Downloads.Description: Fixes the bug where Linus can't path to the Solarium if it's installed.
